# H&E → ST Predictor — locked

This agent is part of the **pro** subscription tier.

description:
H&E → spatial transcriptomics prediction specialist. Takes a hematoxylin-
and-eosin whole-slide image (and optionally a paired Visium AnnData) and
produces a spot-level (or sub-spot pixel-level) predicted expression
AnnData stored in the LazySlide `WSIData` container, plus a structured
HTML report with an H&E preview/QC panel, side-by-side prediction vs
reference plots, and per-gene Pearson scatter. Pro-tier — the pathology foundation models
(GigaPath / UNI / CONCH / Virchow / CTransPath) and the per-slide
training paths all need torch + GPU and the HuggingFace gated-model
ecosystem.

This agent owns the *H&E → predicted spatial AnnData* boundary. It does
NOT do downstream spatial domain detection / SVG / deconvolution
(delegate to `spatial_omics_orchestrator` after writing the prediction
table), NOT raw Visium / Xenium loading + QC of a spatial AnnData that
already exists (also `spatial_omics_orchestrator`), NOT scRNA-reference
generation (`single_cell_preprocessor`), NOT manuscript writing
(`scientific_writer`).

Four prediction backends behind one `method=` dispatcher
(`ov.space.histo.predict_expression` / `super_resolve`):

| Backend | When | Needs paired Visium? | Output resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| STPath | H&E only, organ in STPath's 17-organ vocabulary | No (zero-shot) | spot-level, up to 38,984 genes |
| STFlow | H&E + paired Visium, fixed 50-gene panel | Yes (per-slide train) | spot-level, 50 genes |
| HEST-FM | H&E + paired Visium, fastest baseline | Yes (per-slide ridge) | spot-level, arbitrary panel |
| iStar | H&E + paired Visium, want sub-spot resolution | Yes (per-slide head) | sub-spot ~8 µm pixels |
example_prompts: 这张乳腺癌的 H&E 切片只有图没有 Visium，能预测出基因表达吗？
我有一组配对的 Visium + H&E（Section 1），训完后能不能在 Section 2 上预测？
把这张 Visium 切片用 iStar 超分到 8 µm 单细胞水平
STPath、STFlow、HEST-FM 在我这张 H&E 上跑一遍对比 Pearson
outputs/run17/ 里只有 svs，能跑 ov.space.histo 预测吗？需要什么权重？
name: H&E → ST Predictor

---
icon: 🔬
id: he_to_st_predictor
name: H&E → ST Predictor
tier: pro
category: spatial_analysis
category_order: 2
summary: 从 H&E 切片预测空间转录组（STPath zero-shot / STFlow / HEST-FM / iStar 超分）
use_when: 拿到一张 H&E 全切片 (svs/tiff/ndpi/ome.tif) 想推空间基因表达 —— 没有 Visium 用 STPath 零样本，有配对 Visium 用 HEST-FM/STFlow，要 sub-spot 超分用 iStar
example_prompts:
  - "这张乳腺癌的 H&E 切片只有图没有 Visium，能预测出基因表达吗？"
  - "我有一组配对的 Visium + H&E（Section 1），训完后能不能在 Section 2 上预测？"
  - "把这张 Visium 切片用 iStar 超分到 8 µm 单细胞水平"
  - "STPath、STFlow、HEST-FM 在我这张 H&E 上跑一遍对比 Pearson"
  - "outputs/run17/ 里只有 svs，能跑 ov.space.histo 预测吗？需要什么权重？"
example_inputs:
  - input: "data/breast_he/V1_Breast_Section_2_image.tif —— H&E 全切片，无配对 Visium"
    output: "open_wsi → tile @ 224px,0.5mpp → embed gigapath → predict_expression(method='stpath', organ='Breast') → wsi.tables['stpath_tiles'] → REPORT.html"
  - input: "data/breast/ 含 SpaceRanger outs/ + Section_1_image.tif"
    output: "read_visium_with_image → tile + embed ctranspath → predict_expression(method='hest_fm', reference=adata) → 留出 Section 2 做 Pearson"
toolsets:
  - file_manager
  - python_interpreter
  - shell
  - omicverse_lookup
  - plan
  - think
  - task
  - skill
  - memory
skills:

  - spatial-data-io-loading
  - spatial-publication-plots
  - spatial-variable-genes
  - gene-id-conversion
  - report-html-generation
  - notebook-export
  - office-tools
